name: HeyForm
description: Allows anyone to create engaging conversational forms for surveys, questionnaires, quizzes, and polls. No coding skills required.
composeYaml:
services:
  heyform:
    image: 'heyform/community-edition:latest'
    volumes:
      - 'heyform-assets:/app/static/upload'
    depends_on:
      mongo:
        condition: service_healthy
      keydb:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - 'APP_HOMEPAGE_URL=${APP_URL}'
      - 'SESSION_KEY=${SESSION_SECRET}'
      - 'FORM_ENCRYPTION_KEY=${FORM_SECRET}'
      - 'MONGO_URI=mongodb://mongo:27017/heyform'
      - REDIS_HOST=keydb
      - REDIS_PORT=6379
      - 'REDIS_PASSWORD=${KEYDB_PASSWORD}'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1:9157 || exit 1'
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
  mongo:
    image: 'percona/percona-server-mongodb:latest'
    volumes:
      - 'heyform-mongo-data:/data/db'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - "echo 'ok' > /dev/null 2>&1"
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 5s
  keydb:
    image: 'eqalpha/keydb:latest'
    command: 'keydb-server --appendonly yes'
    environment:
      - 'KEYDB_PASSWORD=${KEYDB_PASSWORD}'
    volumes:
      - 'heyform-keydb-data:/data'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - keydb-cli
        - '--pass'
        - '${KEYDB_PASSWORD}'
        - ping
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 5s

meta.about: Form builder that allows anyone to create engaging conversational forms for surveys, questionnaires, quizzes, and polls.
